description.value: WELA is a health-focused fast-casual restaurant at the Lonsdale Quay Market in North Vancouver, serving globally-inspired healthy bowls, wraps, smoothies, and cold-pressed juices rooted in a Thai philosophy of balance. Founded in 2019, it was designed to bridge the gap between convenience and nutritious eating, with a broad menu of vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Its location near the waterfront entrance of Lonsdale Quay, just a 1-minute walk from the Seabus Terminal, makes it a natural refueling stop for cyclists crossing between North Vancouver and downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (12 spaces) at 52m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Lonsdale Quay Market location of WELA, and the phone number listed as 'Lonsdale Quay Location - (604) 783-9997' matches the OSM tag exactly, corroborating the record. The website FAQ explicitly states dine-in, take-out, and delivery are offered, and the Lonsdale Quay menu page lists numerous items marked Ⓥ (vegan) and GF (gluten-free). No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'WELA Healthy Foods' but website branding is primarily 'WELA'; website title reads 'WELA | Fresh Healthy Foods, Smoothies, and Juices' — minor discrepancy.

Website does not list a street address for the Lonsdale Quay location; OSM address (123 Carrie Cates Court, Unit 132) is plausible for Lonsdale Quay Market but cannot be confirmed from website content.

Website shows an address inconsistency for the Vancouver (non-North Vancouver) location: navigation menu shows '765 Nelson St.' while the FAQ page states '980 Howe St.' — not relevant to this record but suggests some website content may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business at Lonsdale Quay Market with a functioning website and a recent OSM check date of 2026-03-26; well-positioned for cycling tourists using the Seabus corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists multiple items marked Ⓥ (vegan) and GF (gluten-free), including Bangkok Bowl, Green Curry Bowl, Shroomami, Chilango, and Avocado/Falamus wraps. Smoothies described as 'all-natural, no-sugar added, and dairy-free.'
